title: See inference and tool calls as node components inside a harness run
narrative: Fangore runs a tool-loop harness with one tool then a final answer. The console must treat inference and each tool call as node components under a harness parent — not an opaque blob — using the same kinds as recipe interiors. Complements `fangore_traversal_contract` and `fangore_tool_gating`.[^june-nc-harness]
implementation: `ToolLoopHarness` on `AbstractHarness` emits `turn_start`, `inference`, `tool_call`, and `tool_result` with `parent_node_id` / `component_id`. `node_components_for_harness` lists planned components; `traversal_from_events` recovers them after the run.
validation: Kind `harness_tool_loop_graph` → `_run_harness_tool_loop_graph`. Soft expects: status ok; traversal has inference and tool_call with parent harness.
